text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You've taken down quite a few, haven't you?
Good stuff. Huh? Come on, don't get all shy on me.
You gotta take compliments to heart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
結構倒せたんじゃねぇか？
よく頑張ったな。
なんだぁ？
　照れんなって、
褒められたときは
素直に喜べよ♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's keep this up.
We can definitely do this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
この調子でいこうぜ。
あたしらなら、やれるさ。
